page.layout: Running head at top left and page number at top right; one engraved oval portrait with its inscription around the rim (full width, centre); below the portrait one block of four verse lines, centred.

main_text.l: FREDERICVS A TOLEDO, FIL. DUC. ALBAN. DUX OBSID. HARL ET ALCM.
Te Belgica premens. Sed quid insanus furor,
Quid ira invit? Belgica panas dedi.

page.notes: Engraved oval portrait of a man in a plumed hat and ruff, facing left, with the inscription in the rim. The rim inscription is read from the scan and partly uncertain: "FREDERICVS A TOLEDO, FIL. DUC. ALBAN. DUX OBSID. HARL ET ALCM." The verse lines are set in italic and roman mixed type; the words "prabuit", "panas" and "invit" are doubtful. Verse line 1 reads "Imitata patrem nostra se crudelitas," and line 4 "Quid ira invit?" as printed.
